question: What realm is attained by offering flowers of the mālatī plant?
premises: Flowers are used as oblation material.
The flowers specified are of mālatī.
The result is attainment of the worlds of siddhas and gandharvas.
inference: Offering mālatī flowers leads to attainment of the worlds of siddhas and gandharvas.
plain_english: With mālatī flowers one attains the worlds of the siddhas and gandharvas.
